messages.subject: Jake Essex – Professional Solo Vocalist (Elvis & Friends Show) Available for Live Music Nights
messages.body:
Hi Events Team,

I’m Natalie, one of Jake Essex’s agents.

Jake is a professional solo vocalist based in Essex who delivers a high-energy, authentic “Elvis and Friends” show — taking audiences from raw 50s rockabilly through to 70s Vegas powerhouse, mixed with golden-era hits from Sinatra, Bobby Darin, Dion, Roy Orbison and more. He hits every note with real soul, uses quality backing tracks, and focuses on storytelling rather than gimmicks (no jumpsuit — just pure vocals and passion).

If you check his Instagram @JakeEssexMusic or Facebook (@itsjakeessex) you’ll see exactly what he does and hear his voice for yourself. He’s also recently been in talks with The Voice UK producers, but he will always honour every booking he receives.

Jake is already a regular at venues across Essex and consistently gets excellent feedback from both landlords and audiences. He’s fully professional, reliable, and flexible with set lengths (2 × 45 mins or 3 × 45 mins).

Key details for you:
• No deposit required
• Competitive prices
• Discount available for multiple bookings

Jake is looking to add a couple more regular dates in the local area and would love to perform at The Manor House, Tunbridge Wells.

Would you be open to a short chat or a quick demo video? I’m happy to send his latest showreel and availability straight away.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Natalie
Agent for Jake Essex
jakeessexenquiries@gmail.com
